recentItems.description:

Al Jazeera’s Malik Traina reports.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: What is Africa getting from Russia's growing influence?
recentItems.description:
Trade between Russia and Africa reached just $27 billion last year — less than a tenth of Africa’s trade with China.
Russia exports five times more to Africa than it imports.
So, beyond the promises, what are African nations gaining from their growing ties with Russia?

Al Jazeera’s Nicolas Haque reports from Dakar, Senegal.

recentItems.title: What to expect in Burnham's first UK budget
recentItems.description:
The UK finance minister is set to deliver his first budget later on Wednesday, with the government under pressure to ease the cost of living. 
But the war in Iran has driven up energy prices and borrowing costs, leaving little money to spare. 
With finances stretched, Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s government may not be able to afford to deliver on its promises.  

Al Jazeera’s Milena Veselinovic explains how the budget may take shape.
